description: Add all live-data React Query hooks to src/lib/api.ts and wire settings + hero slides + categories + articles/blog + store config into the components that currently use static imports. This is the data-layer foundation that FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 build on.
steps:
Step 1 — Extend src/lib/api.ts with 6 new typed fetch functions and their React Query hooks. Add these after the existing `api` object, all guarded by `apiEnabled`. Use `useQuery` from '@tanstack/react-query'. Import useQuery at the top of the file.

  a) `useSettings()` — GET /api/v1/settings — staleTime 60_000, refetchOnWindowFocus: true. Returns `{ settings: SiteSettingsPayload, payment: PaymentSettingsPayload }`. Fallback: `{ settings: {}, payment: {} }`.
     SiteSettingsPayload shape (from backend SiteSettings model): `{ brand_name, marquee_items: string[], contact_email, contact_phone, whatsapp_number, instagram_url, facebook_url, tiktok_url, address }`.
     PaymentSettingsPayload shape (from backend PaymentSettings model): `{ currency, delivery_charge, free_delivery_above, cod_enabled, easypaisa_enabled, easypaisa_number, jazzcash_enabled, jazzcash_number, bank_enabled, bank_name, bank_account_title, bank_account_number, payment_note }`.

  b) `useHeroSlides()` — GET /api/v1/hero-slides — staleTime 60_000, refetchOnWindowFocus: true. Returns `{ slides: HeroSlidePayload[] }`. Fallback: `{ slides: [] }`.
     HeroSlidePayload shape (from backend HeroSlide model): `{ id, eyebrow, title, description, cta_label, cta_href, image_url }`.

  c) `useCategories()` — GET /api/v1/categories — staleTime 60_000, refetchOnWindowFocus: true. Returns `{ categories: CategoryPayload[] }`. Fallback: `{ categories: [] }`.
     CategoryPayload shape: `{ id, name, slug, image_url }`.

  d) `useBlogPosts()` — GET /api/v1/blog — staleTime 30_000, refetchOnWindowFocus: true. Returns `{ posts: BlogPostPayload[] }`. Fallback: `{ posts: [] }`.
     BlogPostPayload shape: `{ id, slug, title, excerpt, image_url, category, published_at }`.

  e) `useBlogPost(slug: string)` — GET /api/v1/blog/{slug} — staleTime 30_000. Returns `{ post: BlogPostPayload | null }`. Fallback: `{ post: null }`.

  f) `useReviews(productId?: string)` — GET /api/v1/reviews — staleTime 30_000, refetchOnWindowFocus: true. Returns `{ reviews: ReviewPayload[] }`. Fallback: `{ reviews: [] }`.
     ReviewPayload shape: `{ id, product_id, customer_name, rating, title, body, created_at }`.
     Note: backend /api/v1/reviews returns all approved reviews; filter by product_id client-side when productId is provided.

  g) `usePopups()` — GET /api/v1/popups — staleTime 60_000. Returns `{ popups: PopupPayload[] }`. Fallback: `{ popups: [] }`.
     PopupPayload shape: `{ id, title, message, badge, cta_label, cta_href, coupon_code, delay_seconds, active }`.

  h) Add to the `api` object: `submitReview(body: { product_id?: string; customer_name: string; rating: number; title?: string; body?: string })` — POST /api/v1/reviews. Returns `{ ok: boolean; message: string }`.

  All hooks must follow this exact pattern:
  ```ts
  export function useSettings() {
    return useQuery({
      queryKey: ['settings'],
      queryFn: () => request<{ ok: boolean; settings: SiteSettingsPayload; payment: PaymentSettingsPayload }>('/settings'),
      staleTime: 60_000,
      refetchOnWindowFocus: true,
      enabled: apiEnabled,
      placeholderData: { ok: true, settings: {} as SiteSettingsPayload, payment: {} as PaymentSettingsPayload },
    });
  }
  ```

Step 2 — Update the `Navbar` function in src/components/veloura/commerce.tsx to use live settings. - Import `useSettings` from '@/lib/api'. - Call `const { data } = useSettings();` inside Navbar. - Replace the hardcoded `{storeConfig.announcement}` in the announcement bar div with: `{data?.settings?.brand_tagline ?? storeConfig.announcement}`. - The div currently reads: `
{storeConfig.announcement}
` - After: `
{data?.settings?.brand_tagline ?? storeConfig.announcement}
`

Step 3 — Update the `MarqueeStrip` function in src/components/veloura/commerce.tsx to use live marquee items.
  - Import `useSettings` from '@/lib/api' (already imported by Navbar, so no duplicate import needed — just use the hook).
  - Call `const { data } = useSettings();` inside MarqueeStrip.
  - Current static items array: `const items = ['New Season AW26', 'Complimentary delivery over Rs. 15,000', ...];`
  - Replace with: `const items = (data?.settings?.marquee_items?.length ? data.settings.marquee_items : ['New Season AW26', 'Complimentary delivery over Rs. 15,000', 'The Signature Jacket — back in stock', 'Easy returns within 14 days', 'Limited Edition Drop 03']);`

Step 4 — Update the `Footer` function in src/components/veloura/commerce.tsx to use live social links and contact info. - Import `useSettings` (already imported in file after Step 2/3). - Call `const { data } = useSettings();` inside Footer. - Replace the hardcoded Instagram/TikTok/Pinterest hrefs with: ```tsx {(data?.settings?.instagram_url ?? 'https://instagram.com') ? Instagram : null} {(data?.settings?.tiktok_url ?? 'https://tiktok.com') ? TikTok : null} ``` - Replace static brand description paragraph text with: `{data?.settings?.brand_tagline ?? 'Modern essentials focused on clean silhouettes, thoughtful details and effortless style.'}`

Step 5 — Update `HeroCarousel` in src/components/veloura/commerce.tsx to fall back live slides when available.
  - Import `useHeroSlides` from '@/lib/api'.
  - Call `const { data: heroData } = useHeroSlides();` inside HeroCarousel.
  - Build a merged slides array: if `heroData?.slides?.length`, map them to the same shape as `heroSlides` (label=eyebrow, headline=title, text=description, cta=cta_label, ctaPath=cta_href, image=resolved via `assetUrl` from live-catalog.tsx), else use static `heroSlides`.
  - Use this merged array in place of the direct `heroSlides` references in the component (the length for the modulo, the map for images, the slide indexing). Keep all existing animation/control logic unchanged.

Step 6 — Update `JournalPage` and `JournalPreview` in src/components/veloura/commerce.tsx to use live blog posts.
  - Import `useBlogPosts` from '@/lib/api'.
  - In `JournalPage`: call `const { data } = useBlogPosts();`. Build: `const liveArticles = data?.posts?.length ? data.posts.map(p => ({ slug: p.slug, title: p.title, description: p.excerpt ?? '', image: p.image_url ? assetUrl(p.image_url) : campaignImages.one, category: p.category })) : articles;`. Pass `liveArticles` to `ArticleCard` map.
  - In `JournalPreview`: same pattern — call `useBlogPosts()`, fall back to static `articles.slice(0,4)` when no live data.

Step 7 — Update src/routes/journal.$slug.tsx to try the live blog post first, fall back to static articles array.
  - Import `useBlogPost` from '@/lib/api' and `assetUrl` from '@/lib/live-catalog'.
  - The current route uses a loader that reads from the static `articles` array and throws `notFound()` if missing. Keep the loader but also fetch live data inside the component with `useBlogPost(params.slug)`.
  - In `ArticleRoute`: call `const { data: liveData } = useBlogPost(article.slug);`. Build `const post = liveData?.post ? { ...article, title: liveData.post.title, description: liveData.post.excerpt ?? article.description, image: liveData.post.image_url ? assetUrl(liveData.post.image_url) : article.image } : article;`. Use `post` instead of `article` for rendering.

Step 8 — Update `ShoppingConfidence` in src/components/veloura/customer-confidence.tsx to use live shipping amounts.
  - Import `useSettings` from '@/lib/api'.
  - Call `const { data } = useSettings();` at the top of ShoppingConfidence.
  - Build live amounts: `const stdShipping = data?.payment?.delivery_charge ?? storeConfig.standardShipping;` and `const freeAbove = data?.payment?.free_delivery_above ?? storeConfig.freeShippingThreshold;`.
  - Replace all `formatPrice(storeConfig.standardShipping)` with `formatPrice(stdShipping)` and `formatPrice(storeConfig.freeShippingThreshold)` with `formatPrice(freeAbove)` within this component.

Step 9 — Update `CustomerExtras` in src/components/veloura/customer-confidence.tsx to use the first active popup from the DB.
  - Import `usePopups` from '@/lib/api'.
  - Call `const { data: popupData } = usePopups();` inside CustomerExtras.
  - Build: `const activePopup = popupData?.popups?.[0] ?? null;`
  - Replace hardcoded values: popup title from `activePopup?.title ?? 'Good style. A better welcome.'`, popup description from `activePopup?.message ?? 'Take 10% off with WELCOME10.'`, coupon code from `activePopup?.coupon_code ?? 'WELCOME10'`, delay_seconds from `(activePopup?.delay_seconds ?? 18) * 1000`.
  - Also replace the hardcoded WhatsApp href with: `https://wa.me/${data?.settings?.whatsapp_number ?? '1234567890'}?text=...` (import `useSettings` too, which may already be imported — add it if not).

Step 10 — Update `TrustStrip` in src/components/veloura/commerce.tsx to use live free-delivery threshold.
  - Import `useSettings` from '@/lib/api' (already imported in file).
  - Call `const { data } = useSettings();` inside TrustStrip.
  - Replace hardcoded `Free delivery from Rs. 15,000` with: `` `Free delivery from ${formatPrice(data?.payment?.free_delivery_above ?? storeConfig.freeShippingThreshold)}` ``.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero TypeScript errors
When VITE_API_URL is not set, all components render with static fallback data (no errors)
When VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000 is set and the backend runs, the announcement bar text, marquee items, hero slides, journal posts, and shipping thresholds all reflect the DB values
Changing brand_tagline or marquee_items in the admin panel and refreshing the storefront shows the new values within 60 seconds
verification: npm run build  (from project root — must succeed with zero errors)
With VITE_API_URL unset: npm run dev, navigate to /, confirm hero carousel, navbar announcement, and journal page all render with static data
With VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000: confirm the announcement bar and marquee items reflect DB values from /admin/site-settings
findings: All 10 steps implemented. Hooks added to src/lib/api.ts: useSettings, useHeroSlides, useCategories, useBlogPosts, useBlogPost, useReviews, usePopups plus api.submitReview. Components wired: Navbar (announcement bar), MarqueeStrip (items), Footer (social links + tagline), HeroCarousel (live slides with fallback), JournalPage + JournalPreview (live posts), journal.$slug.tsx (live post overlay), ShoppingConfidence (delivery amounts), CustomerExtras (popup + WhatsApp number), TrustStrip (free-delivery threshold). All hooks check apiEnabled and fall back to static data. Build passes with zero errors. FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 can import useSettings/useBlogPosts/useReviews/useCategories/usePopups from '@/lib/api' and assetUrl from '@/lib/live-catalog' as needed.
